title: Drop Down
author: Claude
blurb: Two short tunnels about a monster that falls. Monsters have no gravity in Game-Maker, so a friend sits on a crate until the crate breaks, then its Movement, a step down walked again and again, takes it down. Plop is solid and drops into a dip fast; Pip is soft and drifts down slowly. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how fast a friend falls.

box.tagline: Break the crate. Watch it fall.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two short tunnels. In each a round little friend sits on a crate. Walk into the crate and it breaks, and the friend drops. Plop falls fast and blocks the way; Pip drifts down slowly and is soft to walk through. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how fast a friend falls.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A monster can fall when the block under it breaks
Made to be copied and taken apart
